author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The public capture metadata accepts component even though capture never uses or sends it.
findings.consequence: A future caller can pass a safe component label expecting it to appear in browser telemetry, but capture drops it silently because the compact intake payload only includes event_id, event_name, error_type, resource_kind, and correlation_token.
findings.evidence: Line 278 exposes component in the capture metadata contract; lines 283-298 only read eventName, resourceKind, and correlationToken before enqueueing the compact event. Server intake reconstructs browser events with attributes.component set to null, so the option has no observable effect.
findings.recommendation: Remove component from capture metadata until the compact intake contract supports it, or add a validated component field to BrowserIntakeEvent, client serialization, server validation, and trustedBrowserEvent if component attribution is intended.
